MemoryNote.title: MemoryNote
MemoryNote.description: Persistent long-term memory entry stored by JARVIS for user preferences, ideas, and context.

category.description: Memory category such as Preference, Idea, Project, Personal, or System.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when memory was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when memory was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PriorityTask.title: PriorityTask
PriorityTask.description: Actionable task or timed reminder created autonomously by JARVIS or manually by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when task was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when task was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CustomMacro.title: CustomMacro
CustomMacro.description: User-defined one-click or voice-triggered automation macro.

voiceTrigger.description: Optional voice phrase that triggers this macro.

promptCommand.description: Command or prompt dispatched to JARVIS when triggered.

iconKey.description: Icon identifier for HUD macro button.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when macro was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when macro was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WriterDocument.title: WriterDocument
WriterDocument.description: AI Studio Writer and Code Pad draft generated by JARVIS or authored by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when document was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when document was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-scoped priority task matrix and timed reminders.

/users/{userId}/documents/{docId}.description: User-scoped AI Studio Writer and Code Pad drafts.
